name: Kiro CLI
description: AWS Kiro CLI - agentic AI 编码助手（IDE/CLI/Web 统一），基于 Amazon Bedrock，免费层含 50 积分/月 + 开放权重模型/Claude Sonnet 4.5

methods.name: adl 下载安装 (推荐, 多线程+代理测速)
methods.command: set -e; ARCH="$(uname -m)"; [ "$ARCH" = "arm64" ] && KIRO_ZIP=kirocli-universal-darwin.zip || KIRO_ZIP=kirocli-universal-darwin.zip; KIRO_URL="https://prod.download.cli.kiro.dev/stable/latest/${KIRO_ZIP}"; KIRO_DIR="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/kiro-adl-$$.d"; mkdir -p "$KIRO_DIR"; if command -v adl >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo '[INFO] 使用 adl 下载（多线程+断点续传+代理测速）'; adl "$KIRO_URL" "$KIRO_DIR" "$KIRO_ZIP"; else echo '[WARN] adl 不可用，回退 curl'; curl -fsSL "$KIRO_URL" -o "$KIRO_DIR/$KIRO_ZIP"; fi; [ -s "$KIRO_DIR/$KIRO_ZIP" ] || { echo '[ERROR] 下载产物为空'; exit 1; }; mkdir -p "$KIRO_DIR/extract"; unzip -q "$KIRO_DIR/$KIRO_ZIP" -d "$KIRO_DIR/extract"; mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin"; install -m 755 "$KIRO_DIR/extract/kirocli/bin/kiro-cli" "$HOME/.local/bin/kiro-cli"; rm -rf "$KIRO_DIR"; echo '安装完成: kiro-cli 已装到 ~/.local/bin'; kiro-cli --version

update.command: set -e; KIRO_URL="https://prod.download.cli.kiro.dev/stable/latest/kirocli-universal-darwin.zip"; KIRO_DIR="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/kiro-update-$$.d"; mkdir -p "$KIRO_DIR"; if command -v adl >/dev/null 2>&1; then adl "$KIRO_URL" "$KIRO_DIR" "kirocli-universal-darwin.zip"; else curl -fsSL "$KIRO_URL" -o "$KIRO_DIR/kirocli-universal-darwin.zip"; fi; mkdir -p "$KIRO_DIR/extract"; unzip -q "$KIRO_DIR/kirocli-universal-darwin.zip" -d "$KIRO_DIR/extract"; install -m 755 "$KIRO_DIR/extract/kirocli/bin/kiro-cli" "$HOME/.local/bin/kiro-cli"; rm -rf "$KIRO_DIR"; echo 'Kiro CLI 更新完成'; kiro-cli --version

operations.view: ls -la $HOME/.kiro 2>/dev/null || echo '配置目录不存在（未登录）'
operations.edit: echo 'Kiro 配置通过 kiro-cli 子命令管理，或编辑 ~/.kiro 下配置文件'
reset: echo 'Kiro 登录信息删除请执行: kiro-cli logout'

notes: Kiro CLI 免费层：$0/月，50 积分/月，开放权重模型 + Claude Sonnet 4.5（有额度限制）。登录用免费层：Google/GitHub 社交登录或 AWS Builder ID（无需自己的 AWS 账户）。安装后必须先 kiro-cli login --license free --use-device-flow 才能发起对话。Kiro CLI 3.0+ 是单一 standalone kiro-cli 二进制，装到 ~/.local/bin（需在 PATH）。
post_install: echo '  Kiro CLI 安装成功！'
echo 'Kiro CLI 免费层可用（$0/月，50 积分/月）。'
echo '安装后必须先登录才能发起对话：'
echo '  kiro-cli login --license free --use-device-flow   # 免费层（Google/GitHub 社交登录或 AWS Builder ID）'
echo '  kiro-cli whoami                                   # 确认登录'
echo '  kiro-cli login --social google   # Google 社交登录'
echo '  kiro-cli usage        # 查看积分用量'
